sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1992
ACT IV OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN
SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S
(SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1992.
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (IVof 1975)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th April, 1992]
No. PAB/LEGIS: III(3)/92,
dated 30-4-1992.----The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1992 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on the 18th March, 1992 and assented
to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances 'and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
